articles.summary: With people living longer overall, diagnoses of cancer, cardiovascular disease, and other aging-related diseases are increasing. Advancements in medical imaging technologies further enable more widespread screenings, prevention and treatment of various medical conditions.
articles.title: Medical Imaging Trends Impact on Advanced Power Technologies – Part 1: Ultrasound and X-Ray

articles.summary: Precise and appropriate power conversion plays a crucial role in medical system development but is often considered too late in the design cycle. This can lead to significant consequences such as delays in certification time and increased development and system costs.
articles.title: How to Choose the Right Power Partner for Medical System Design – Free White Paper

articles.summary: Board-mounted power modules offer a convenient and compact solution to system power-supply challenges. However, any switched-mode power converter can be a source of electromagnetic interference (EMI), which needs to be correctly managed.
articles.title: EMI Management for Board-Mounted Power Modules
